about.metaDescription: BAIA is a family swimwear brand inspired by the Mediterranean coast.
about.title: Born on the Mediterranean coast
about.intro: BAIA started with a simple idea: swimwear the whole family can love, designed for long days between the sea and the sand.

sections.title: Designed for real summers
sections.body: Every piece is cut for movement and made with quick-drying fabrics that keep their shape and colour season after season.

sections.title: For the whole family
sections.body: From toddlers to grandparents, our collections are designed to sit together — coordinated colours, never matching for the sake of it.

sections.title: Made with care
sections.body: We work with a small number of trusted manufacturers and keep our collections focused, so every piece earns its place.

shipping.metaDescription: Shipping times, costs and coverage for BAIA Swimwear orders in Israel.
shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.intro: We ship across Israel. Here's what to expect once you place your order.
shipping.costFlat: Orders under {threshold} ship for a flat {cost}.

sections.title: Delivery times
sections.body: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days. Delivery usually takes 3–5 business days after dispatch. Remote areas may take longer.

sections.title: Tracking your order
sections.body: Once your order ships we'll email you a tracking number. You can also see the status of your orders in your account.

sections.title: International shipping
sections.body: At the moment we only ship within Israel.

returns.metaDescription: How to return or exchange BAIA Swimwear items — easy 14-day returns.
returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.intro: Not quite right? You can return or exchange items within 14 days of delivery.

sections.title: Conditions
sections.body: Items must be unworn, unwashed and returned with original tags and hygiene liners attached. For hygiene reasons, swimwear without its liner cannot be accepted.

sections.title: How to return
sections.body: Contact us with your order number and the items you'd like to return. We'll send you instructions and a return address.

sections.title: Exchanges
sections.body: Need a different size or colour? Let us know when you contact us and we'll reserve the replacement for you, subject to stock.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days of receiving your return, in accordance with Israeli consumer protection law.

contact.metaDescription: Get in touch with BAIA Swimwear — questions about sizing, orders and returns.
contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions about sizing, an order or a return? We're happy to help and usually reply within one business day.
contact.name: Your name
